fullPromptRole: The full-generation text is an independent final-intent prompt. The exact literal prompts executed for each attempt follow, without claiming that the consolidated prompt itself was sent as one call.

steps.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE complete PORTRAIT 2:3 watercolor illustration, 1024 by 1536, for an adult Persian advice book. THREE equally tall horizontal panels stacked TOP TO BOTTOM, white gutters and clean airy white outer margins. Same camera distance and character scale in every panel. Full bodies, BOTH complete feet of each person and the entire simple workbench visible in EACH panel, floor margin beneath soles. References148 and131 are STYLE references only.
Advice: "Worth repeating: Measure twice, cut once." First measure the picture width, then independently check that SAME width using the actual picture as a physical gauge, THEN cut one molding only once.
SAME VIOLET adult frame-maker in plain cream apron on LEFT, SAME ORANGE adult friend with no clothes on RIGHT. Two neutral medium adult figures, same straight build and circular head sizes in all panels. Sparse small frame-making workshop, no clutter. SAME small square landscape picture, SAME single long straight narrow wooden frame molding on bench. A small fixed wooden stop at the molding's LEFT end is the common ZERO ORIGIN. Picture and molding parallel and both aligned to this same left stop. Molding continues right beyond intended length as excess. Camera slightly from above to clearly show picture edge, molding and mark. No completed frame at any point.
TOP: The square picture lies FLAT on bench immediately BEHIND and parallel to the molding. Both left edges touch the same LEFT STOP. VIOLET holds one taut tape across picture's exact horizontal top WIDTH from LEFT corner to RIGHT corner, looking at its right endpoint; a small straight square bridges the picture's right edge to the molding directly below, where one tiny pencil line marks that same length. VIOLET's two hands anchor tape and mark the molding naturally; ORANGE observes the junction attentively without extra tools. Saw safely unused on wall hook. Thought bubble from VIOLET exactly «اندازه‌اش اینه...».
MIDDLE: No cutting tool has touched wood. The SAME picture itself is now directly against the SAME molding as a full-size gauge, their LEFT edges precisely aligned at the SAME fixed wooden stop. ORANGE independently checks that SAME intended molding length by holding the picture and setting one small straightedge across its RIGHT edge onto the EXISTING pencil line on molding, clearly verifying alignment. The right picture edge and marked molding point line up exactly. VIOLET looks closely at that actual junction. Tape rests unused behind them. ORANGE says exactly «یه بار دیگه؛ درسته!» with connected bubble tail to ORANGE. Real objects in direct contact, no floating picture or ruler; no dimension change, no measuring the picture height.
BOTTOM: Picture placed safely upright at the rear of bench. Same molding securely supported in ONE simple miter box and clamp, SAME left stop and one verified pencil line. VIOLET makes exactly ONE hand-saw cut at that confirmed line, with one fresh small kerf. Saw blade within safe miter-box slot, cut proceeds away from body; free violet hand on molding well LEFT of blade, fingers away from slot. ORANGE stands at a safe distance on right and watches, hands naturally behind back. No extra cuts, no detached four-side frame, no scattered pieces. VIOLET smiles calmly and says exactly «حالا فقط یه برش!».
Character anatomy directly matches148: truly CIRCULAR heads equal width/height, no chin/jaw, no neck/nose/ears/hair. Small DARK vertical OVAL eyes, each with one tiny white internal glint, NO white sclera. Colored outlines are darker violet/orange LOCAL BODY COLOR, not black. Subtle local-color contact shadow under head. STRAIGHT neutral torso sides and pelvis, no bust, waist indentation, projecting hips or buttocks. Medium adult limbs, neither fat nor skinny sticks. Every fully visible hand exactly THREE FINGERS plus ONE THUMB, four total; natural grips may hide digits. Same identity, head diameter, height and limb thickness through all scenes. Faint diffuse blush only, no stamped circles.
Broad irregular overlapping translucent WATERCOLOR WASHES visibly inside heads, bodies, arms, hands and legs; luminous paper, large gentle pigment variation and restrained pooling as148. No uniform crystalline noise, tiny tiled speckles, marker, flat vector or glossy 3D. Only the three specified short connected Persian RTL bubbles, no English, numerals, labels, extra text or watermark. Gentle adult wit comes from two friends carefully checking one small molding. Clear physical cause and effect.

Use case: illustration-story. ONE PORTRAIT 2:3 watercolor, THREE equal horizontal panels stacked top to bottom. An adult book illustration of "Measure twice, cut once." STYLE ONLY from148 and131: broad layered translucent watercolor, circular no-neck heads, medium straight adult bodies, tiny dark oval eyes with internal white glints, colored contours.
FRAMING IS ESSENTIAL: show TWO COMPLETE STANDING ADULTS from circular head to BOTH FEET in EACH panel. Pull the camera far back. Their whole bodies occupy about three quarters of each panel's height. Floor below feet and generous white margin; no part of any foot or body touches a panel edge. Bench is small and low enough to reveal legs and feet below. Same scale, heads, build, camera and simple sparse room across all panels. VIOLET wears a straight cream apron on left; ORANGE no clothes on right. Their torso sides and pelvis are neutral and straight, no bust/waist/hip curves. No noses, ears or hair. Exactly three fingers plus thumb per hand, natural grips.
SAME ONE long straight wooden molding and SAME small square unframed landscape picture. On bench, molding runs horizontally LEFT to RIGHT. A wooden STOP fixes its LEFT end. Picture lies FLAT immediately behind molding, parallel to it, with its LEFT edge ALSO touching that SAME left stop. Its right edge defines the one pencil cut mark on molding. Maintain this geometry and picture width unchanged across first TWO panels. No upright picture until final panel. Saw unused until final panel. Do NOT measure picture height.
TOP: VIOLET actually measures picture's horizontal WIDTH with one taut yellow tape from its LEFT edge at stop to RIGHT edge. A small square bridges right picture edge to a single pencil mark on molding. ORANGE watches. Bubble from VIOLET exactly «اندازه‌اش اینه...».
MIDDLE: actual INDEPENDENT second check of SAME width: ORANGE uses the SAME FLAT picture as a direct physical gauge. Left picture edge at SAME stop, right picture edge lies exactly at the SAME pencil mark on molding, verified by a small square across both. ORANGE holds picture/square; VIOLET watches. Tape set aside. No cut. Bubble from ORANGE exactly «یه بار دیگه؛ درسته!».
BOTTOM: Picture moved upright safely to rear. VIOLET makes ONE hand-saw cut at the confirmed mark on SAME molding, clamped in a simple miter box. One fresh kerf only. Free hand well left of blade, saw away from torso, orange friend watches safely at right with hands behind back. No completed frame, no extra cuts or pieces. Bubble from VIOLET exactly «حالا فقط یه برش!».
Keep all heads geometrically circular, identical diameter and scale through panels, medium adult build neither fat nor skinny. Faces have ONLY eyes, eyebrows and mouth; leave space between eyes and mouth BLANK, absolutely no nose mark. Small dark oval eyes have NO white sclera. Darker local violet/orange outlines, never black. Faint diffused cheek warmth, no flat circles. Broad luminous irregular watercolor WASHES inside bodies and heads, no fine speckled tiles or crystalline texture. Plain sparse backdrop and white margins/gutters; no decorative plants or extra tools. Only these three Persian connected RTL bubbles, no English, numerals, labels or watermark.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this three-panel portrait frame-making watercolor. Fix ONLY the spatial continuity of picture width, left origin and cut point. Keep all complete bodies/feet, circular heads, facial identity, body proportions, poses as much as needed, white margins, watercolor, all Persian bubbles VERBATIM and three-panel layout.
In TOP and MIDDLE panels, make the SAME flat picture exactly the SAME visible width at this same camera scale, about 200 pixels. Its LEFT edge must physically TOUCH the RIGHT FACE of the wooden left stop, with absolutely NO empty gap between picture left edge and stop. Picture lies flat immediately behind the same molding and parallel to it. Its RIGHT edge must align exactly with the single pencil line on molding via the square. No upright picture in these panels. TOP tape zero physically touches the same stop/picture left edge and tape extends exactly across the picture width to its right edge, not beyond.
Use these approximate image-coordinate landmarks to clarify: TOP zero origin at x280 and right picture edge/pencil line at x480. MIDDLE zero origin at x395 and right picture edge/pencil line at x595. Thus SAME 200-pixel width/length is verified twice although the board is slightly shifted on table. In middle move the square and mark LEFT to x595, matching that picture's right edge, and align picture left at the stop x395. Orange holds picture/square and looks at that junction. This is a physical second measurement of same dimension.
BOTTOM uses that SAME verified length of molding: zero origin at the right face of left stop about x165, one cut at x365, SAME 200-pixel distance. Move miter-box cut slot, one pencil line, and saw blade contact to that one position. Adjust violet's working arms naturally so one hand grips saw and free hand rests safely WELL LEFT of blade, no fingers near teeth. Cut away from torso. Same long molding and one fresh kerf only; no extra cuts or pieces, no finished frame. Keep all tools mechanically sensible and wood supported/clamped. Keep all hands exactly three fingers plus one thumb with natural grip occlusion. No noses or white sclera. Do not crop any foot or shrink characters.

localHandling: Selected original tool PNG copied byte-for-byte to canonical path. No raster postprocessing, CLI/API image generation, site, Excel, Images, feedback or Git changes.
legacyDrafts: Older original-draft prompt files and preexisting unpublished draft PNGs were preserved; they were not substituted for the selected outputs.
